◐ vb-8iilq [BUG] · Remove test-only shard submission behavior that fabricates contracts and capability grants   [● P0 · IN_PROGRESS]
Owner: Lewis · Assignee: Lewis · Type: bug
Created: 2026-10-21 · Started: 2026-10-21 · Updated: 2026-10-21

DESCRIPTION
At reviewed checkpoint61930db1, crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/lifecycle/chunk_001.rs defines separate cfg(test) implementations of handle_submit and handle_submit_with_inputs. They detect Do, fabricate action registry contracts and capability grants, and handle_submit injects I64(0) inputs, while production paths pass user data unchanged with empty registry. This makes unit tests exercise different admission/dispatch behavior and masks missing inputs/contracts/capabilities. Required: a single production path in all builds, move fixture construction explicitly into test helpers/call sites, preserve meaningful exact error and behavior assertions, real package integration tests against non-cfg runtime, full targeted suites, independent code and test review. No proof-planning detour, no assertion weakening, no fabricated waiver.

/bin/zsh -lc "cat > .beads/vb-8iilq/contract.md << 'EOF'
# VB-8IILQ Contract: Remove Test-Only Shard Submission Fabrication

## Objective
Remove the "'`cfg(test)` alternative implementations of `handle_submit` and `handle_submit_with_inputs` that detect Do actions and fabricate action contracts, capability grants, and I64(0) inputs. Ensure a single production implementation exists for all builds.

## Scope
- File: `crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/lifecycle/chunk_001.rs`
- Remove two `#[cfg(test)]` handler implementations
- Remove two `#[cfg(not(test))]` markers from production handlers
- Remove orphan `#[cfg(test)]` fabrication helpers (`test_first_do_action`, `test_contract_required_capability`, `test_contract_grants`, `test_action_contract`, `test_contracts_through`)
- Move fixture construction explicitly into test helper modules/call sites
- Do NOT change real production admission/security branches

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Single production body for `handle_submit` and `handle_submit_with_inputs` in all builds
2. No fabricated contracts, grants, or inputs injected at handler layer
3. Legitimate action tests explicitly supply typed contracts/grants/inputs at test fixture calls
4. Real production missing/invalid inputs/contracts/caps remain rejected
5. No all-in-one test wrapper secretly overrides restricted grants
6. Negative admission and actual API semantics retained
7. Full `--lib` build passes with real test counts and assertions
8. No new `expect`, `unwrap`, `panic`, index, cast, or ignored results

## Implementation Notes
- Tests that relied on fabricated contracts must be updated to explicitly provide them
- Tests that relied on fabricated grants must explicitly provide the capability set
- Tests that relied on I64(0) input injection must explicitly provide inputs
- Preserve genuine denied capability and malformed input negative tests
- Scope is chunk_001.rs + test fixtures/call-sites only
EOF'
